title: Segment Any Motion with Radar: Robust Multimodal Moving-Object Segmentation and Tracking
abstract: arXiv:2609.08346v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Moving-object perception must decide which image regions correspond to real motion and keep every instance identified over time. Methods that read motion from appearance, optical flow, or estimated trajectories lose that evidence under poor illumination, adverse weather, reflections, and occlusion. Radar is a natural remedy because it measures radial velocity directly instead of inferring it from photometric correspondence. However, existing benchmarks do not jointly provide radar measurements, dense moving-instance masks, and temporally consistent identities for surveillance. We therefore introduce RGBTR-Motion, a synchronized and calibrated fixed-camera benchmark that pairs RGB, thermal, and radar streams with dense instance masks and temporally consistent identities across diverse surveillance scenes. We also develop SAM-Radar, an RGB, thermal, and radar-based segmentation and tracking framework built on SAM 3. SAM-Radar's radar-awa

translated_title: 基于雷达的运动分割：鲁棒的多模态运动目标分割与跟踪
translated_abstract: 运动目标感知必须判断哪些图像区域对应真实运动，并在时间推移中保持对每个实例的身份追踪。那些从外观、光流或估计轨迹中读取运动信息的方法，在弱光照、恶劣天气、反射和遮挡条件下会丢失这些证据。雷达是一种天然的解决方案，因为它直接测量径向速度，而不是从光度对应关系中推断。然而，现有的基准数据集并未能同时为监控场景提供雷达测量数据、密集的运动实例掩码以及时间一致的身份标识。因此，我们提出了RGBTR-Motion，一个同步且经过标定的固定相机基准数据集，它在多种监控场景中将RGB、热成像和雷达数据流与密集实例掩码及时间一致的身份标识相配对。我们还开发了SAM-Radar，一个构建于SAM 3之上的、基于RGB、热成像和雷达的分割与跟踪框架。SAM-Radar的雷达感知机制（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文提出了首个同步RGB-热成像-雷达多模态监控基准数据集RGBTR-Motion，并开发了基于SAM 3的分割跟踪框架SAM-Radar，利用雷达直接测量径向速度的优势，在光照不良、恶劣天气、反射和遮挡等困难条件下实现鲁棒的运动目标分割与跟踪。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces RGBTR-Motion, a synchronized RGB-thermal-radar surveillance benchmark with dense instance masks and temporally consistent identities, and SAM-Radar, a SAM 3-based segmentation and tracking framework that leverages radar's direct radial velocity measurements for robust moving-object perception under poor illumination, adverse weather, reflections, and occlusion.
